艺倡画廊很荣幸能接力易凯先生的巡展-因果相随。该展到我画廊之前，首发于美国加州的: Alisan Fine Arts is honoured to host the next stop of Yi Kai’s travelling exhibition, What Goes Around Goes Around. Before coming to our gallery, the exhibition opened at Claremont Graduate University in California and then travelled to 53 Art Museum in Guangzhou.
记得初见易凯的画时，我瞬间就被他艺术中的符号和色彩与线条的律动所吸引。1993年: When I first saw Yi Kai’s paintings, I was immediately drawn to their symbols and the rhythm of their colours and lines. Alisan Fine Arts first introduced Yi Kai to Hong Kong in a group exhibition in 1993, followed by solo exhibitions in 1998 and 2000.
经过多年的实践和探索，这最新的一组作品征明了易凯大胆的画风以及他对有文化底蕴艺术: After years of practice and exploration, this latest body of work demonstrates Yi Kai’s bold approach to painting and his passion for art with cultural depth. To me, the ambiguity between landscapes, people and ideas most clearly expresses his examination of human interactions and the many paths surrounding them. Following the success of the previous three exhibitions, it is a pleasure for us to host his travelling exhibition again.
（写于易凯个人三地巡展画册）: (Written for the catalogue of Yi Kai’s three-city solo exhibition.)
自1985年以来，不少中，青年中国艺术家来台湾办展。易凯个展是其中最为成功的一个: Since 1985, many young and middle-aged Chinese artists have exhibited in Taiwan. Yi Kai’s solo exhibition is among the most successful.
（在观看易凯1989由皇冠艺文中心举办的个人展览后留下评价）: (Comment after viewing Yi Kai’s 1989 solo exhibition presented by the Crown Art Center.)
易凯的色彩是绚丽的，是梦幻与现实融洽如水的色彩？ 是美梦与恶梦结合一体的色彩？是: Yi Kai’s colours are dazzling. Are they colours in which dreams and reality flow together like water? Colours joining beautiful dreams with nightmares? Colours of wondrous fairy tales and magnificent myths? Madness may be only nascent in Yi Kai’s paintings, but their dreamlike quality is unquestionably powerful and draws me in. One colour-and-ink painting, Prayer, combines brilliant blue, intense yellow and a sacred white. A person dressed in white stands on a roof, gazing at the sky. Is there a sun in that sky, and a bird within the sun? What do you pray for: rain and dew, blessings, love? The house, the person, the orb and the bird all begin to turn, and the great wheel of thought rumbles. From dreams emerge mystery and history; sentimentally speaking, beauty; flatteringly speaking, Yi Kai’s thought, the style of thought and the thought of style.
后来居上。: The later arrival surpasses those who came before.
源于自然，胜于自然，新为美。: From nature, beyond nature: newness is beauty.
